Create a 3:4 vertical, full-body environmental portrait with the visual character of a real smartphone photograph, closely preserving the reference composition and atmosphere.  A young adult woman, visually around 22–28, sits extremely low in the center of an outdoor garden pavilion. She has a slim elongated frame, narrow shoulders and a naturally narrow waist, with long straight deep black-brown hair falling below her chest in a clean center or near-center part. Preserve the reference facial proportions: a narrow oval face, delicate jawline, relatively large eyes, slim straight nose and small soft lips. Do not redesign the face into exaggerated Western high-bone-structure glamour or an extreme influencer V-line.  She looks directly into the camera with calm, slightly enlarged but believable eyes and subtly lifted outer corners. Her lips remain gently closed and almost neutral. There is no smile. Her expression feels quiet, soft and slightly detached, as though she had just settled into the shade of the garden; an emotion from the previous second still lingers, while the moment feels as though it could break again at any time.  Use a contemporary East Asian social-media soft-glam makeup language compatible with modern qipao styling: fair neutral-to-cool pink foundation, soft semi-matte skin, slim black eyeliner extending slightly outward, pale pink-brown eyeshadow, fine natural brows, very restrained blush and low-saturation dusty-rose or nude-pink lips. Keep it refined but not theatrical, heavily contoured or overly artificial.  Dress her in a soft powder-pink / dusty-pink sleeveless high-neck qipao, with a Mandarin collar, diagonal closure and delicate traditional pink frog-button details. The fabric should look like silk or satin, decorated with very low-contrast gray-pink floral or ink-wash botanical motifs. The bodice fits the chest and waist naturally without looking excessively tight. The chest remains fully covered and only shows a restrained natural contour through the fitted satin fabric.  The qipao has high side slits. In the low seated pose, substantial portions of both thighs become visible through the slits, while the center skirt panel drops naturally between the legs in irregular, gravity-driven satin folds. Avoid perfect symmetry in the drape.  She is sitting on a very low stone seat or ledge, hips close to the ground, torso facing directly toward the camera and remaining relatively upright while the shoulders stay relaxed. Both knees open widely toward the sides, creating the distinctive broad triangular lower-body composition from the reference. Because the thighs and knees are closer to the lens, allow a believable amount of 24–28mm smartphone wide-angle perspective, making the knees slightly more prominent without stretching the legs into impossible proportions.  One arm is raised with the elbow bent, the fingers loosely holding a thin white cigarette-like stick, with no prominent smoke. The opposite arm hangs naturally beside the other knee and lower leg. Keep slight differences in shoulder level, wrist rotation, elbow position and knee height instead of creating perfectly mirrored anatomy.  She wears pale nude-pink or light beige delicate square-toe strappy heels with thin ankle straps. Add only a small dark brown-black beaded bracelet on the wrist at frame right and a very thin minimalist ring on one finger of the lowered hand. No additional jewelry and no visible phone.  Accurately preserve the visible skin regions. Visible skin includes the entire face and neck, both shoulders, both arms and hands, large portions of both thighs through the high side slits, the knees, lower legs, ankles, tops of the feet and toes. The chest, abdomen, waist, back and buttocks remain covered by the qipao.  Her skin is fair with a neutral-to-slightly-cool pink undertone. It may show mild smartphone beauty retouching, but it should still feel tactile and human: the upper arms and thighs look softly matte, smooth and supple, while the knees, knuckles and ankles retain faint natural texture, joints and subtle anatomical changes. Do not create poreless plastic skin. Weak frontal fill keeps the face, shoulders, arms and legs relatively even in brightness, with very soft highlights rather than oily shine.  The setting is a shaded outdoor garden pavilion surrounded by dense greenery. A gray-brown wooden bench or railing runs horizontally behind her. A black garden lamp post rises vertically from directly behind the center of her head, with part of its round white lamp globe visible near the upper frame. Preserve this accidental overlap rather than correcting it into a cleaner professional composition.  Surround the pavilion with dense dark green broadleaf plants and tree branches. The foreground consists of rough gray stone tiles with cracks, stains, irregular patterns and natural tonal variation.  Use physically believable daytime lighting beneath a dense tree canopy. The sky behind the subject is extremely bright and locally blown out to white, while the foliage underneath falls into deep green shadow. The subject receives soft skylight and possibly a very weak frontal phone flash or localized exposure lift, causing her face, shoulders and limbs to remain brighter and more evenly exposed than the darker vegetation. Facial shadows remain shallow. Do not introduce dramatic side lighting, a studio three-point setup, strong artificial rim lighting or warm golden-hour sunset tones.  Shoot with the visual behavior of a 24–28mm full-frame-equivalent smartphone main camera, approximately 1.5–2 meters from the subject. Position the camera around the seated subject's upper-abdomen to waist height, slightly below her eye line, giving an extremely subtle low-angle perspective. Frame her completely from the top of the head to the shoes.  Use moderate-to-deep depth of field: the woman is sharp, while the wooden railing, nearby foliage and stone-floor texture remain clearly readable, with only mild softening in more distant greenery. Avoid an 85mm f/1.4 creamy-bokeh look.  The final image should feel like a genuine casual phone photograph that received only mild social-media beauty processing, not a flawless commercial fashion campaign. Preserve small imperfections: mild skin smoothing mixed with digital sharpening, slight exposure inconsistency, clipped sky highlights, leaves partially obstructing the background, the lamp post awkwardly intersecting the head, messy stone-floor texture, minor body asymmetry, subtle digital noise and light compression artifacts.  The emotional identity is a quiet, restrained, slightly distant modern-qipao moment in summer garden shade. She had already become still, yet the photograph feels as though this particular moment is about to disappear.  Negative prompt: minor, mirror selfie, phone covering face, standing pose, extreme hourglass body, impossible long legs, exaggerated lips, heavy Western glam, plastic skin, wax face, excessive skin smoothing, extra fingers, malformed hands, malformed knees, perfect mechanical symmetry, extreme 85mm bokeh, creamy background blur, studio rim light, golden sunset, overprocessed HDR, synthetic AI skin, sterile cleaned background, heavy smoke.

Create a 3:4 vertical, realistic indoor digital portrait of a clearly adult woman in her early-to-late twenties, standing against a completely plain warm gray-white wall. Frame her from the head down to roughly the thighs or knees, with generous negative space above her head. She has a deep brown, almost black, chin-length bob with softly inward-curving ends and thin blunt bangs separated into small natural strands. The hair should be smooth but not synthetic, retaining a little natural flyaway texture and subtle warm-brown reflections in the light.

She looks directly into the camera while placing both hands behind her head or at the back of her hair, opening her elbows widely to form a broad triangular frame around her face and shoulders. Do not make the elbows perfectly level or the shoulders mechanically symmetrical. Let most of her weight rest on one leg while the other leg shifts slightly forward or sideways, producing a small natural hip shift and an understated S-curve through the torso. The pose should feel like a spontaneous social-media portrait pose that she happened to hold for a moment, not a precisely choreographed fashion pose.

Dress her in a black velvet modernized qipao-inspired mini dress: sleeveless, halter-style, with a high or mandarin-collar impression, several black Chinese-style frog closures running down the center chest, and small vertical openings between the closures. The fitted skirt ends around the upper-to-mid thigh and features a high side slit revealing part of one upper thigh. The velvet should absorb most light and remain deep black, showing only soft silver-black reflections along folds, curved areas and the hem. Never make the material look like latex, PVC or glossy leather. Add delicate black lace ruffled wrist cuffs on both wrists.

Visible skin includes the face, most of the neck, both shoulders, upper arms, underarm areas, part of the forearms, and both thighs beneath the hem and through the side slit. The chest and waist remain mostly covered. Skin is light neutral-to-slightly-warm, brightened by the contrast with the black dress without becoming pure white. It should look fine-textured and soft, as though it would feel warm, smooth and gently resistant to the touch rather than ceramic or plastic. Preserve faint pores, tiny tonal changes around the elbows and underarms, and subtle real-skin irregularities.

Keep a compact oval face, delicate short chin, large-eye visual balance, refined nose bridge and slender facial proportions. Makeup follows a soft K-pop idol glam blended with Japanese doll-like portrait makeup: light semi-matte foundation, thin elongated black eyeliner, individually separated lashes, very subtle aegyo-sal with muted pink-brown lower-eye shading, a cool gray-blue contact-lens-like iris appearance, naturally slim brows, restrained nose contour, and muted rose-bean or soft brown-red lips. Her eyes remain fully open and fixed on the lens. Her lips are closed or barely parted with only the slightest upward curve, creating a composed expression that feels as though she has already held the pose for several seconds.

Photograph it like a premium smartphone or compact digital camera portrait taken casually in a room, not a commercial studio campaign. Use perspective comparable to a 35–50mm full-frame equivalent lens, with the camera around chest-to-shoulder height, nearly frontal and just slightly below eye level. Allow a tiny framing offset or subtle tilt instead of mathematically perfect centering. Rendering should be slightly soft, with mild consumer-camera texture, faint sensor grain, low-to-moderate contrast and natural edge softness rather than aggressive sharpening.

The primary physical light source is a large window positioned front-right of the camera, producing broad diffused daylight. It first illuminates the right cheek, shoulder, upper arm and legs with wide creamy highlights that remain low in oiliness. The left side receives only gentle wall-bounce fill and gradually falls darker. No hard flash, no dramatic rim light and no sharp studio shadows. The wall itself should be a little brighter on the right and subtly darker on the left, with minor unevenness that feels like genuine room light.

The final atmosphere is quiet, soft-dark, slightly doll-like and subtly intimate, combining a black modernized qipao, short bob hairstyle and minimalist East Asian social-media portrait aesthetic. It feels as if she had already tried several poses beside the window that afternoon; a second earlier she was adjusting her hair, the camera caught the brief pause with both hands behind her head, and a second later she might lower her arms again. Preserve the slightly uneven shoulder line, imperfect elbow positions, natural skin-tone variation and faint digital noise so the image feels photographed by a real person rather than polished into an immaculate AI advertisement.

Negative prompt: underage, childlike body, extra fingers, deformed hands, warped arms, broken elbows, plastic skin, porcelain skin, extreme hourglass, oversized breasts, latex dress, PVC shine, busy background, neon lighting, hard flash, strong rim light, mirror selfie, phone in hand, over-retouched, over-sharpened, heavy bokeh.

9:16 竖版，超写实真人摄影 × 新中式旗袍 Editorial × 江南园林 × 清雅奢华电影感。

两人必须呈现真实东亚女性真人脸，但保持明显不同的五官辨识度，避免生成双胞胎或复制脸。肌肤非常白皙、细腻、通透，呈自然冷白瓷肌色调，带淡淡粉润血色，同时保留真实毛孔、细小绒毛与自然皮肤纹理。

左侧女性：深棕黑色齐肩直发自然向后梳理，小巧鹅蛋脸，深褐色杏仁眼，纤长自然睫毛，平直黑眉，精致鼻梁与淡玫瑰色嘴唇，神情平静、清冷、内敛。

她身穿浅米色 × 香槟色现代改良旗袍式迷你裙，取消传统高立领，改为非常明确的大深 V 低领设计。V 型领口自然向下延伸，展现肩颈、清晰锁骨与较多上胸线条，自然呈现 E 罩杯视觉的丰满曲线。裙身加入精致深色植物、飞鸟与东方花卉纹样，腰部修身收束，短裙摆自然展现修长腿部。

腿部搭配轻薄黑色透明丝袜与亮面黑色尖头高跟鞋。她端坐在长椅上，上半身自然挺直，一条腿优雅搭在另一条腿上，一只手自然停留在身体侧面，另一只手轻搭长椅或栏杆，动作克制从容。

右侧女性：浅金棕色长发盘成优雅低发髻，额前点缀一朵精致白色花朵发饰。小巧鹅蛋脸，大而自然的杏仁眼，细致眼线、浓密但真实的睫毛、修长眉形、精致鼻梁与淡粉色双唇，神态温柔、自信，带轻微自然笑意。

她身穿黑灰色现代改良旗袍式迷你裙，同样采用明显的大深 V 低领设计，展现肩颈、锁骨与较多上胸线条，自然呈现 E 罩杯视觉。裙身加入大面积浅灰白东方花卉纹样，前侧为利落短款剪裁，后侧延伸一层较长的半透明深色轻纱，使短款旗袍具有更丰富的层次和动态感。

腿部搭配轻薄黑色透明丝袜与亮面黑色尖头高跟鞋。她自然侧坐或轻松交叠双腿，一只手轻搭腰侧，另一只手自然扶住长椅或栏杆，姿态松弛、优雅。

两人的坐姿、手势、发型与神态保持明显差异，避免完全对称或复制粘贴式动作。整体呈现东方古典韵味 × 现代女性时尚感 × 高级旗袍 Editorial 的自然反差。

长椅后方是一道精致的黑色几何纹样中式镂空栏杆。背景自然分布茂密绿色芦苇、垂柳、层层叠叠的树叶以及平静泛着青绿色光泽的池水。水面具有真实倒影、轻微涟漪与细腻空气透视，远处园林植物自然形成丰富空间层次。

采用 9:16 竖版双人中全景构图，两位女性从完整头顶、真人面容、深 V 改良旗袍、纤细腰身、坐姿、修长双腿一直到高跟鞋尽量完整呈现。人物位于画面中下部，园林与池塘在后方自然延伸，避免人物过度挤满画面。

光线采用明亮柔和的阴天自然散射光，人物脸部、肩颈、锁骨与白皙肌肤保持均匀通透，没有生硬阴影。池水和绿色植物形成柔和环境补光，使浅香槟与黑灰旗袍的材质、刺绣和花纹保持清晰。

整体采用真实手持智能手机摄影视角，加入非常轻微的构图倾斜、自然曝光变化与生活化摄影瑕疵，但人物眼睛、面部、皮肤、发丝、旗袍纹样、丝袜与鞋履保持高清清晰。色调以冷白、香槟米色、黑灰、墨绿与青绿色为主，低饱和、清雅、温润而高级。

负面提示词： 未成年外观，儿童化面容，两人长相完全相同，双胞胎脸，复制脸，传统高立领，领口过高，V领过浅，胸部过度夸张，完全裸露胸部，衣物滑落，长裙完全遮腿，大头，大脸，短腿，身体比例失衡，坐姿畸形，腿部反折，多余腿，多余手臂，多手多指，丝袜结构错误，高跟鞋变形，衣物穿模，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，动漫脸，CG脸，严重过曝，严重模糊，背景杂乱，AI伪影，文字，Logo，水印。

生成一张 16:9 横版、纯白背景 的 旗袍结构与工艺细节图鉴，整体风格为 现代简洁图鉴页 + 高端服饰结构研究图 + 新中式极简服装解析页，画面干净、明亮、克制、精致，具有清晰的设计感与传播感。

画面顶部设置完整的标题说明区，排版简洁高级、留白充足：

主标题：“现代改良无袖旗袍”
副标题：“结构与工艺细节图鉴”
顶部风格说明行：“新中式极简｜米白提花丝绸｜祥云暗花提纹｜米白底・浅金滚边”
右上角系列标签：“新中式系列”

背景必须是 纯白色，不要米白、不要宣纸色、不要复古纸张感。

画面中央是一位 22–32 岁的成年东方女性，气质 清雅、现代、克制，五官 清秀知性，轮廓柔和，东方感明确，发型为 简洁低髻。人物姿态自然稳定，正面站姿或轻微 3/4 角度，完整露出全身，双臂不要遮挡服装结构，整体重点是展示旗袍，不是拍人物写真。

低立领结构
简化斜襟走向
极简一字盘扣
无袖肩部轮廓
修身腰线与腰省关系

无袖肩部
腰省
开衩
提花纹理
滚边工艺

结构放大图：领口、襟线、无袖肩部、开衩

极细虚线
手绘感曲线
单向箭头
小圆点定位
优雅克制，不要科技信息图风

领口
襟线
无袖肩部
腰省
开衩
提花纹理
滚边工艺

米白提花丝绸 面料小样
浅金滚边 色卡小样
简约一字盘扣 工艺小样

纯净感
现代结构感
新中式极简气质
面料提花的细腻层次
米白与浅金的高级配色
图鉴感、设计研究页感、可传播性

Then, using the initial image in Seedance 2.5, along with this prompt and character sheets as references (optional), we can generate the clip.

This one is actually in Draft Mode, so it only costs 6K credits!

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
Real amateur phone video, one continuous 30-second take with no cuts, filmed by a tourist at a crowded castle viewpoint in Central Europe. Handheld vertical phone, shaky grip, restless digital zoom that keeps pushing in and pulling back, smeary detail, compression and autofocus hunting. Misty overcast daylight, cool grey haze.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]
<<img1>> is the first frame: the video starts exactly on it. <<img2>> provides the redneck man's face, build, long hair, beard, black hoodie, jeans and boots. <<img3>> provides the woman's face, build and long wavy hair.

[TIMELINE]
0-1s: Exactly <<img1>>. Tourists murmur in German and point at the smoke rising from the ruined castle, surprised.
1-4s: [Crash digital zoom to medium] The phone zooms hard across the valley and settles on the castle courtyard inside the broken walls, grainy and soft. Clearly visible: a barbecue grill full of sausages pouring out the smoke, a white plastic table with a Jack Daniel's bottle, a cooler, a big loudspeaker, a dusty RV parked by the keep, an inflatable kiddie pool with the woman sitting in it, and on the man's left an old bronze medieval cannon on a wooden carriage, its muzzle aimed straight at the camera.
4-8s: [Second push-in, tight] The man by the grill finishes a long swig from the Jack Daniel's bottle, turns to the pool and clinks the bottle against her raised can. They toast and drink.
8-12s: [Pan to the RV, slow push-in] A black cat jumps down from the RV door and trots toward the man with its tail straight up.
12-15s: [Ease out to medium] The man grins and points at the cannon. The cat turns and walks to the cannon.
15-18s: [Push-in on the cannon] The cat swats the fuse with its paw. The fuse catches and starts spitting sparks, burning down fast.
18-21s: [Jerky zoom out to wide] The phone pulls back to the whole crag. Tourists gasp and start backing away, shouting in German.
21-23s: [Wide, locked on the castle] A bright flash and a puff of white smoke from the battlement, then a heavy boom echoes across the valley. A black cannonball grows bigger and bigger, flying straight at the viewpoint.
23-26s: [Phone jolts] The cannonball whooshes just over the tourists' heads and smashes into a rock outcrop beside the viewpoint, bursting stone chunks and dust. Screams.
26-30s: [Phone swings while running] Chaos, tourists flee down the path in panic. The phone whips around and lands for a moment on a brown historic-monument sign by the path, the word "TECHHALLA" clearly readable in white letters.

[AUDIO]
German tourist chatter, gasps, shouts and screams close to the phone, wind in the valley. Thrash metal plays from the loudspeaker the whole time, distant and tinny, louder while zoomed in. A small meow, fuse hiss, a deep cannon boom, the whoosh overhead and the crack of shattering rock. No subtitles.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Photorealistic phone footage, real digital zoom artifacts, coherent physics, the same two people, one cat and one cannon throughout, stable identities, natural motion blur, realistic cannon recoil, smoke and flying rock debris.

She wears a sharply tailored black evening jacket constructed from semi-sheer floral lace with integrated black crystal embroidery and subtle tonal sparkle visible only when struck by light. The silhouette is aggressively sculpted through the waist with structured shoulders and elongated sleeves. Beneath the jacket is a fitted black lace corset bodice that transitions into ultra-sheer patterned tights featuring a woven geometric monogram motif. Black patent pointed stilettos create a continuous leg line. Multiple strands of pearls drape from the waist and hips. A miniature structured black handbag hangs from one hand. Fine diamond jewelry catches occasional highlights. Her hair is arranged in an elevated editorial updo with loose strands escaping naturally around the face and neck.

The camera remains physically close to the subject, using an 85mm editorial perspective. She occupies roughly one-third of the frame height and immediately dominates the composition. Facial expression, eye direction, lace texture, jewelry hierarchy, and body language are clearly readable without zooming. The viewer should notice her first, then the crowd, then the city.

The composition captures her mid-stride moving through the crossing. One foot is planted while the opposite leg advances naturally. The handbag swings subtly with movement. Her posture is relaxed, self-assured, and completely unconcerned with the attention surrounding her.

Salarymen in suits, students in uniforms, tourists, shoppers, elderly couples, office workers, and streetwear enthusiasts move through the scene with different destinations and priorities. Foreground depth is created through partially obscuring pedestrians crossing close to camera. First, let's take a look at the initial frame, generated with @magnific One (best for pure realism) using this prompt 👇

A crowded stone viewing platform in the forested hills of Central Europe on a misty late morning, with wooded ridges and grey rock crags rising on every side so the viewer feels surrounded by them. In the foreground, a handful of adult tourists lean on the old iron railing: a man in a navy rain jacket seen from behind holding up his phone, a woman in a mustard knit beanie and green fleece in profile, a backpack strap and a shoulder cut by the edges. Far in the background, across a deep wooded valley, stands one sheer vertical crag of grey rock topped by a half-ruined medieval castle: a broken keep tower with empty window holes, crumbled curtain walls and a collapsed corner. From inside the ruined walls, near the broken keep, a thin plume of grey smoke rises into the pale sky. The castle and the smoke are small and distant, readable only as a jagged stone silhouette and a soft grey thread.

COMPOSITION:
Shot type: wide, distant
Angle: eye level from behind the railing crowd, looking across the valley, horizon tilted a few degrees
Placement: tourists filling the lower third and the left edge, the castle crag in the upper center-right, the smoke rising from the ruin in the upper right third, other wooded ridges fading into haze on both sides
Look-room: right
Foreground: mild occlusion, a blurred tourist shoulder and a raised phone at the bottom left edge
Crop: handheld, slightly imperfect.

CAMERA PACK:
Body: ordinary mid-range Android phone, held vertically at eye level over the heads of the crowd
Lens / zoom: 3x digital zoom from the main lens, the glass slightly smudged
Aperture or phone mode: normal photo mode, auto exposure set for the bright sky
Focus: the far crag and castle reasonably sharp, the nearest tourists a little soft
Film or sensor: small-sensor phone texture, heavy processing from the digital zoom, JPEG compression

LIGHT:
Source: diffuse overcast daylight through valley mist
Quality: soft, low contrast, with haze layering the distant ridges
Color temperature: cool neutral daylight, slightly blue-grey in the mist
Shadows follow that source.

PHOTOGRAPHIC CHARACTER:
Fabric weave, seams and creases on the rain jacket, beanie and fleece.
Grain or sensor texture that matches the camera pack.
Candid stance, catalog-unaware.
Highlights a little hot, the sky and mist clipped to plain white, the shaded forest and rock faces blocked up and noisy.
Smeary watercolor detail from the digital zoom on the far trees, the castle stones and the smoke.
Crunchy phone sharpening halos along the crag edges, the broken towers and the railing, blocky compression in the mist.
Slight overall softness from the raised, shaky grip.
Plain, slightly green-shifted color straight out of the phone, an ordinary snapshot by a friend.

Then, using the initial image in Seedance 2.5, along with this prompt and character sheets as references (optional), we can generate the clip.

This one is actually in Draft Mode, so it only costs 6K credits!

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
Real amateur phone video, one continuous 30-second take with no cuts, filmed by a tourist at a crowded castle viewpoint in Central Europe. Handheld vertical phone, shaky grip, restless digital zoom that keeps pushing in and pulling back, smeary detail, compression and autofocus hunting. Misty overcast daylight, cool grey haze.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]
<<img1>> is the first frame: the video starts exactly on it. <<img2>> provides the redneck man's face, build, long hair, beard, black hoodie, jeans and boots. <<img3>> provides the woman's face, build and long wavy hair.

[TIMELINE]
0-1s: Exactly <<img1>>. Tourists murmur in German and point at the smoke rising from the ruined castle, surprised.
1-4s: [Crash digital zoom to medium] The phone zooms hard across the valley and settles on the castle courtyard inside the broken walls, grainy and soft. Clearly visible: a barbecue grill full of sausages pouring out the smoke, a white plastic table with a Jack Daniel's bottle, a cooler, a big loudspeaker, a dusty RV parked by the keep, an inflatable kiddie pool with the woman sitting in it, and on the man's left an old bronze medieval cannon on a wooden carriage, its muzzle aimed straight at the camera.
4-8s: [Second push-in, tight] The man by the grill finishes a long swig from the Jack Daniel's bottle, turns to the pool and clinks the bottle against her raised can. They toast and drink.
8-12s: [Pan to the RV, slow push-in] A black cat jumps down from the RV door and trots toward the man with its tail straight up.
12-15s: [Ease out to medium] The man grins and points at the cannon. The cat turns and walks to the cannon.
15-18s: [Push-in on the cannon] The cat swats the fuse with its paw. The fuse catches and starts spitting sparks, burning down fast.
18-21s: [Jerky zoom out to wide] The phone pulls back to the whole crag. Tourists gasp and start backing away, shouting in German.
21-23s: [Wide, locked on the castle] A bright flash and a puff of white smoke from the battlement, then a heavy boom echoes across the valley. A black cannonball grows bigger and bigger, flying straight at the viewpoint.
23-26s: [Phone jolts] The cannonball whooshes just over the tourists' heads and smashes into a rock outcrop beside the viewpoint, bursting stone chunks and dust. Screams.
26-30s: [Phone swings while running] Chaos, tourists flee down the path in panic. The phone whips around and lands for a moment on a brown historic-monument sign by the path, the word "TECHHALLA" clearly readable in white letters.

[AUDIO]
German tourist chatter, gasps, shouts and screams close to the phone, wind in the valley. Thrash metal plays from the loudspeaker the whole time, distant and tinny, louder while zoomed in. A small meow, fuse hiss, a deep cannon boom, the whoosh overhead and the crack of shattering rock. No subtitles.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Photorealistic phone footage, real digital zoom artifacts, coherent physics, the same two people, one cat and one cannon throughout, stable identities, natural motion blur, realistic cannon recoil, smoke and flying rock debris.

A young adult woman with refined, symmetrical facial features, fair semi-neutral skin, green eyes, clean naturally shaped nude makeup, sleek high ponytail. She is wearing large gold floral drop earrings and a green-and-gold baroque patterned top. Face slightly turned, looking slightly off-camera, calm and composed.

**COMPOSITION**  
Tight vertical fashion portrait. Face occupies the upper half of the frame. The woman’s face is close to the lens. Crop cuts just below the collarbone / upper chest. Hand rests on the upper chest near the neckline. Large gold floral earrings sit on the right side of the frame.

**POSE**  
Elegant fashion-model pose. Head slightly tilted. Chin gently lowered. Gaze directed slightly off-camera. Expression calm, reserved, and elongated. One hand rests on the upper chest with fingers softly spread.

**HAIR**  
Long dark hair pulled into a sleek, extremely tight high ponytail, positioned behind the crown of the head. Hair is smooth, glossy, and neatly controlled. Face is fully visible. No loose strands across the face.

**MAKEUP**  
Luxury editorial makeup. Skin appears refined and almost poreless. Soft natural-looking complexion with gentle warmth. Defined but natural brows. Subtle eyeshadow, softly defined lash line, and elongated lashes. Neutral nude-pink lips with a slight sheen. No heavy contour. Soft highlight on the high points of the face.

**SKIN**  
Flawless, luminous, lightly dewy skin. Soft glow on the forehead, cheekbones, and nose bridge. Natural texture kept subtle. No heavy retouching look.

**LIGHTING**  
Dramatic, directional studio lighting against a nearly black background. A strong, sculptural key light from the upper left / front-left of the frame. Deep shadows on one side of the face. High-contrast cinematic lighting with sharp highlights and rich shadow.

**IMPORTANT VISUAL / LIGHT EFFECT**  
A vertical prism / rainbow light leak cuts across the face, neck, and chest like a glass or crystal refraction. Iridescent bands of cyan, blue, green, magenta, and gold travel down the skin. The effect should look photographic and physically plausible, not digitally painted.

**BACKGROUND**  
Dark, near-black studio background. Minimal space around the subject. No visible set pieces.

**WARDROBE**  
Luxury dark emerald-green top with gold baroque / Versace-style floral pattern. Fabric looks silk or satin. Neckline wraps around the neck and opens across the chest. The garment is slightly reflective.

**JEWELRY**  
Large statement floral gold earrings on the visible ear: stacked gold flower forms with dimensional petals and a metallic sheen. A thin gold necklace may be visible at the neck.

**HAND**  
A feminine hand with long, clean, natural nude nails rests on the upper chest. Fingers slightly curved, relaxed, and elegant.

**CAMERA**  
Professional beauty / fashion photography look. Tight crop, approximately 35–50mm portrait feel. Sharp focus on the eyes. Shallow depth of field. High-end editorial sharpness.

**IMAGE QUALITY**  
Photorealistic, ultra-detailed, high-end fashion magazine quality. Visible skin micro-texture, fabric weave, metal highlights, and realistic light refraction. No illustration look.

**COLOR PALETTE**  
Deep black background, warm skin tones, emerald green, antique gold, with prismatic rainbow highlights.

**MOOD**  
Mysterious, refined, high-fashion, luxurious, slightly cold editorial glamour.

**CRITICAL DIRECTIVES**  
Keep the subject’s overall facial identity from the reference. Maintain the same face structure, eye color, brows, nose, lips, and skin tone. Preserve the rainbow light streak, gold floral earrings, green-and-gold patterned top, and hand-on-chest pose. Photorealistic, not AI-plastic.

I wanted a Halloween poster with zero skeletons and zero clichés.

The idea: a "Haunted Garden". An abandoned Victorian greenhouse at night, carnivorous plants, glowing mushrooms, a pumpkin swallowed by ivy.

Instead of prompting the poster straight away, I built the art direction first in Adobe Firefly Boards:
→ 1 locked palette
→ 6 moodboard shots
→ 1 final poster, 3 typography styles

In this thread: the model I picked and why, the reference-image mistake that kept ruining my shots, and the prompt trick for clean text on a poster 🧵

This post is sponsored by Adobe Firefly through a paid partnership, showcasing my experiences as a Brand Ambassador for their innovative platform. All opinions are my own.

Made entirely with @AdobeFirefly AI tools.

Try Adobe Firefly: https://adobe.ly/SpookyFF

#AdobeFireflyAmbassadors #Ad  #HowToAdobeFirefly

The framing words that worked:
"extreme macro"
"fills the frame"
"background completely out of focus"
"no sky visible" (to finally get rid of that moon 🌕)

Wide shot, medium shot, macro, still life: a moodboard needs range, not 6 versions of one image.

The final poster pulls one element from each moodboard image.

Type tip: put your text in quotes and describe the font rather than naming it ("high-contrast serif, Victorian engraving style").

prompts.text:
I am looking on a few more hybrid prompts that combine conceptual art with political commentary.  I tested it with GPT 2.5, Nano Banana 2.1, Flux 3 and Nano Banana Pro 

2x2 grid, AI infers topics, 16:9 CLASSIFY(input) → {
  domain:      editorial_illustration × conceptual_art × political_commentary
  intent:      persuade + provoke + distill (the "unforgettable glance")
  audience:    op-ed readers, magazine subscribers, visual intellectuals
  platform:    print (magazine cover, editorial header), scalable to 4cm thumbnail
  complexity:  extreme (requires strict metaphor singularity, physical print simulation, 
                        and absolute rejection of literalism and digital rendering)
}

CORE DESIGN LAWS (IMMUTABLE):
  ⚠ ONE METAPHOR. ONE SUBSTITUTION. ZERO TEXT.
  • Substitution: Change Scale XOR Material XOR Function. Never two.
  • Restraint: No text, no arrows, no forehead symbols. Ambiguity ≠ Confusion.
  • Treatment: 3-4 flat colors, 1 texture, shape-first, generic faces.
  • Medium: Physical print character (Riso, screenprint, litho).
  • Survival: Must read perfectly at 4cm wide.

SEMANTIC_VARIABLES (AI infers entirely from {{THESIS}}):
  {{THESIS}}          → [USER PLUGS IN: e.g., "Tech monopolies are extracting 
                         behavioral data like 19th-century colonial rubber barons."]
  {{BENEFICIARY}}     → AI infers the winner (e.g., The Algorithm / The Corporation)
  {{VICTIM}}          → AI infers the loser (e.g., The User / The Public)
  {{TENSION}}         → AI infers the core conflict (e.g., Extraction vs. Autonomy)
  {{FAMILIAR_SCENE}}  → AI infers the baseline visual (e.g., A Victorian rubber plantation)
  {{SUBSTITUTION}}    → AI selects exactly ONE wrong element (Scale, Material, OR Function)
  {{PALETTE}}         → 3-4 flat colors inferred from the tension
  {{TEXTURE}}         → The single print artifact (Riso grain, screenprint halftone)

prompt：https://promptsref.com/zh/tool/AI-Image-Generator/share/7f8df62f48e81561e96ed5cf55a8c297

Create an authentic vertical café portrait that feels casually photographed by a friend, not a polished commercial shoot. The subject is a clearly adult young woman, apparent age around 20–25, seated inside a relaxed café filled with warm wooden furniture. She has very long, very dark brown hair approaching black, mostly straight with only faint natural bends. Keep a relaxed near-center part, gentle volume at the crown, loose face-framing sections and several imperfect flyaway strands crossing the cheek. The hair should look naturally soft and smooth, never groomed into shampoo-ad perfection.  She is seated with her torso angled slightly toward the camera, while her head turns distinctly toward frame-left. Her eyes are also directed outside the frame to the left rather than toward the lens. Her gaze is soft and slightly absent-minded, carrying the mild curiosity of someone whose attention was just caught by a nearby voice. Her lips are slightly parted as if she is about to answer someone. Keep her shoulders relaxed and mildly asymmetric, with a subtle forward lean and gentle torso twist. One arm falls naturally downward while the other crosses diagonally toward her lap or knee area. The pose should feel interrupted mid-conversation rather than professionally directed.  Preserve a soft small oval facial structure, naturally narrow jawline, understated nose bridge and softly full lips. Avoid aggressive face slimming or artificially enlarged eyes. Use understated makeup inspired by the translucent everyday beauty styling common in contemporary East Asian urban fashion: a thin natural base, softly shaped brows, muted taupe-brown eyeshadow, extremely fine eyeliner, natural lashes, pale peach-pink blush and hydrated rose-pink lips. The face must still read as real human skin rather than retouched AI perfection.  Dress her in a cream or ivory vintage floral strapless dress with tiny botanical flowers in dusty pink, soft rose, muted mauve, pale green and olive-brown. The bodice should be fitted with a lightly corseted construction, sitting horizontally across the chest. The neckline reveals the full shoulders, collarbones, upper chest and natural cleavage while the breasts remain covered by the garment. Do not increase nudity or exaggerate bust size. Let the fitted construction define a naturally slender waist without creating an extreme hourglass ratio. The matching skirt should bunch naturally around the lap in the seated pose, showing real compression folds and wrinkles.  Visible skin includes the face, ears, neck, both shoulders, collarbones, upper chest and cleavage area, both arms and a small amount near the underarm edges. The abdomen, hips, back and legs remain essentially covered. Skin tone is light neutral-warm, with a faint pink cast in the cheeks and subtle peach warmth reflected from the wooden interior onto the neck, shoulders and arms. The surface should appear fine, softly hydrated and smooth while retaining tiny pores, faint tonal variations and ordinary human texture. Its tactile impression should feel warm, finely textured, soft, smooth and gently elastic rather than plastic, waxy or porcelain.  Add only one tiny silver-white or pearl-like round stud earring. Keep accessories minimal.  Place the camera slightly above eye level, approximately 10–20 degrees higher, angled gently downward from close range. Aim for the visual character of a smartphone main camera, compact digital camera or small interchangeable-lens camera around 28–40mm full-frame equivalent, with an f/1.8–f/2.8 depth-of-field feel. Use an approximately 3:4 vertical frame, somewhere between a medium-close and half-body portrait. Keep her roughly centered but not mathematically symmetrical, with modest headroom and the bottom naturally cropping around the thighs or knees.  Do not use studio lighting. The key light should feel like a large window or bright doorway positioned in front of the subject and slightly camera-left, producing broad, soft diffused illumination across the face, shoulders, collarbones, upper chest and arms. Keep highlights on the forehead, nose bridge and collarbones soft and low contrast. Let the wooden floor, tables and walls return faint warm amber bounce into the skin. Avoid hard flash, obvious directional light, artificial rim lighting or carefully engineered commercial three-point lighting.  The background is a genuinely occupied casual café: a large wooden table behind her on the left, honey-brown wooden chairs, several tall stools farther back, warm wooden floorboards, and a chair on the right with turquoise-green metal legs. Allow partially cropped patrons or human silhouettes near the edges of the frame. Furniture does not need to be perfectly aligned. Chair backs, table edges and background figures may be awkwardly cropped, creating the layered clutter of a real public interior.  The image should not be excessively sharp. Add slight softness, restrained sharpening, fine digital noise, mild JPEG/social-media compression and subtle consumer-camera rendering. The background should be somewhat soft while tables and chairs remain recognizable. Very light in-camera beautification is acceptable, but never erase real skin texture or create a plastic AI face.  Most importantly, preserve the feeling of a moment that had already begun and is about to continue. She had been talking with someone in the café and, a second ago, her attention was elsewhere. Now she has just turned toward the left and her lips have begun to part. A second later she might answer, look down again, or break into a small smile. The photograph should feel like an ordinary afternoon memory captured by someone familiar with her, not an editorial fashion production.  Intentionally retain imperfections: slight softness, framing drift, loose hair across the face, partially blocked furniture, background clutter, casually positioned arms, mild digital grain and compression. Avoid perfect symmetry, studio polish, strong HDR, aggressive sharpening, dramatic rim light, enlarged eyes, exaggerated bust, extreme waist-to-hip proportions, increased nudity, text, watermark or logos.  Negative prompt: minor, mirror selfie, looking directly at camera, exaggerated bust, extreme hourglass body, excessive cleavage, plastic skin, waxy face, porcelain skin, giant eyes, razor-sharp jawline, heavy makeup, strong HDR, oversharpening, hard flash, rim light, studio lighting, seamless backdrop, perfect symmetry, stiff posing, oversaturated colors, CGI, 3D render, AI-smooth skin, text, watermark, logo.

prompts.text:
Format: 30-second photorealistic vlog video, 
Style: Real-camera documentary footage, natural daylight, physically accurate motion, no CGI or fantasy effects.

CHARACTER / REFERENCE LOCK
Use the woman from @Image as the exact identity reference. Preserve her face, facial features, hair, body proportions, outfit, skin texture, and overall appearance throughout the entire video. Do not redesign or alter her identity.

SCENE 01 — STATIC ROOM INTRO | 0–5s
A woman stands inside the original real-world interior exactly as shown in the source footage. The camera is completely static and locked, with absolutely no pan, tilt, zoom, shake, reframing, or camera movement.

Show her front side first, facing directly toward the camera in a natural handheld-vlog-style performance even though the camera itself remains completely stationary. She looks into the lens, smiles naturally, and casually says:

[“Okay, come with me. I want to show you something really beautiful.”]

Her expression, face, hair, clothing, body position, lighting, shadows, and background remain pixel-identical to the original footage until the door begins opening.

SCENE 02 — THE DOOR OPENS | 5–9s
She turns naturally toward the door and opens it.

The doorway does not reveal the original background. Instead, it opens directly onto a real outdoor landscape at human eye level.

No transition effect. No portal effect. No flash. No glow. No particles. No distortion. The doorway itself remains physically realistic.

Soft natural sunlight spills through the open doorway. A gentle breeze subtly moves her hair and clothing.

She looks back toward the camera with a pleasantly surprised smile and says:

[“Wait… look at this.”]

SCENE 03 — STEPPING INTO THE LANDSCAPE | 9–14s
She steps naturally through the doorway onto real grass.

Outside is a huge green valley under natural daylight. Scattered white Victorian-style farmhouses with porches sit throughout the valley, connected by winding dirt roads and bordered by natural hedges.

The foreground grass has detailed, realistic texture.

A line of gigantic ancient sequoia trees rises dramatically from one side of the valley. Their trunks have rough, fibrous bark and enormous natural canopies extending high overhead.

Real blue sky, soft cumulus clouds, atmospheric haze, and distant hills create authentic outdoor depth.

She walks a few steps forward, looks around, then turns toward the camera and says:

[“This place feels like it came straight out of a dream.”]

Her movement remains completely natural and physically believable.

SCENE 04 — RUNNING THROUGH THE FIELD | 14–20s
She suddenly becomes more playful and begins running freely across the grass toward the valley.

Natural human running mechanics, realistic foot placement, believable weight shifts, consistent body proportions, realistic hair and clothing movement.

The camera remains locked in its original position. She gradually becomes smaller in the frame as she runs away from the doorway and across the field.

She laughs naturally and says:

[“Come on, let’s go!”]

The grass moves gently in the breeze. Tree branches sway subtly. Shadows shift naturally across the ground.

SCENE 05 — VALLEY EXPLORATION | 20–25s
Cut naturally to a new real-camera shot from farther inside the valley.

The woman walks along a narrow dirt path between tall grass and hedges, looking around with genuine curiosity.

She briefly turns toward the camera and says:

I haven't done prompts for composers for a while. This one actually works better with Nano Banana. I like the output a bit better. 

Prompt: <instruction>
Input A is a legendary composer (Beethoven, Mozart, Bach, Tchaikovsky, John Williams, Hans Zimmer, etc.) or a specific symphony/score (Beethoven's 9th, Star Wars, The Rite of Spring, etc.).
Analyze: The composer's appearance and era, the musical structure (movements, themes, instrumentation), emotional arc, and historical context/premiere reception.
Goal: A physical architectural model where the symphony is built as a walkable structure with movements as rooms/levels.
Rules:
- Overall structure: Multi-story building/cathedral model representing the complete work
  * Architectural style matching the music's era and character:
    - Baroque = ornate cathedral (Bach)
    - Classical = balanced palace (Mozart)
    - Romantic = dramatic castle (Tchaikovsky)
    - Modern = abstract structure (Stravinsky)
    - Film score = cinematic landscape (Williams)
  * Each movement/section as distinct architectural space
  * Structural integrity showing how movements support each other
- Ground floor entrance: Opening movement
  * Grand entrance hall with main theme carved into walls
  * Composer figurine conducting at threshold
  * Original premiere audience figurines entering (period costumes)
  * Date and location of premiere
  * Initial reception (riot for Rite of Spring, triumph for Beethoven's 9th)
- Interior rooms/levels (one per movement):
  * Movement 1: Foundation/exposition room
    - Main themes as architectural motifs
    - Key signature and tempo as structural elements
    - Instrumentation visible (miniature orchestra sections)
  * Movement 2: Development level
    - Themes transforming through space
    - Harmonic journeys as hallways and passages
    - Tension/conflict as architectural stress points
  * Movement 3: Scherzo/contrast chamber
    - Lighter, playful architecture if scherzo
    - Or slow, meditative space if adagio
    - Rhythmic patterns in floor tiles
  * Movement 4: Finale crown/dome
    - All themes converging
    - Triumphant height or tragic collapse depending on work
    - Choir balcony if vocal finale (Beethoven 9th)
- Musical notation integration:
  * Actual sheet music fragments embedded in walls
  * Leitmotifs as recurring decorative elements
  * Dynamic markings (forte, piano) as physical size changes
  * Crescendos as ascending staircases
  * Tempo changes visible in architectural rhythm
- Include:
  * Instruments as structural supports (strings = foundation, brass = pillars, etc.)
  * Emotional journey marked by color and light through rooms
  * Key changes as transitions between architectural styles
  * Silences/rests as empty spaces, voids, breath
  * The innovative elements that shocked contemporaries highlighted
- Composer's workshop: Adjacent construction office
  * Composer figurine at drafting table with score
  * Crossed-out attempts, revisions
  * Personal crisis visible if relevant (Beethoven's deafness, etc.)
  * Letters describing the work's meaning
  * How long composition took (years often)
- Modern visitors: Contemporary listeners walking through structure
  * Experiencing music architecturally
  * Different interpretations by different conductors shown as lighting variations
  * Famous recordings as alternative walk-throughs
- Materials: Architectural model craftsmanship, sheet music paper, miniature instruments, concert hall details
- Lighting: Each movement lit according to its character (bright major keys, shadowy minor), dramatic spotlighting on climaxes
- Style: Synesthetic experience, music made tangible, architectural precision meets emotional power
Output: ONE image, 3:4 vertical showing full building height, musical architecture visualization
</instruction>

Animals doing naughty things. Here is a prompt template for this: 

2x2 grid, 16:9, animals getting caught doing annoying things: SUBJECT=[...]

VARIANT_SEED=[optional value; change this to force a fresh concept]

Create ONE highly shareable humorous image about SUBJECT.

Do NOT begin with a fixed visual template.

Do NOT automatically use:
cats,
animals,
mugshots,
police lineups,
signboards,
anthropomorphic characters,
or any previously successful scene.

Instead:

────────────────────────────────────
PHASE 1 :: UNDERSTAND THE SUBJECT
────────────────────────────────────

Infer:

CORE_IDENTITY =
what SUBJECT is fundamentally associated with

PUBLIC_ASSOCIATIONS =
things people immediately recognize about SUBJECT

FRUSTRATIONS =
annoying / inconvenient / contradictory aspects

BEHAVIORS =
things SUBJECT metaphorically or literally "does"

STEREOTYPES =
recognizable harmless cultural associations

TENSIONS =
expectation vs reality,
confidence vs competence,
appearance vs behavior,
promise vs outcome,
cause vs consequence,
etc.

EMOTIONAL_HOOK =
relatable / absurd / smug / chaotic / wholesome /
frustrating / ironic / dramatic / deadpan / awkward

────────────────────────────────────
PHASE 2 :: GENERATE VISUAL JOKES
────────────────────────────────────

Internally generate at least 12 substantially different concepts.

Possible humor mechanisms include but are NOT limited to:

- anthropomorphic behavior
- role reversal
- visual metaphor
- literalized idiom
- exaggerated consequence
- fake documentary evidence
- absurdly official treatment of trivial behavior
- product parody
- museum exhibit
- before / after
- expectation / reality
- inappropriate confidence
- scale mismatch
- historical reinterpretation
- future reinterpretation
- object behaving like a person
- person behaving like the subject
- fake warning / instruction
- environmental storytelling
- visual contradiction
- hidden reveal
- deadpan realism
- surreal transformation
- mock scientific classification
- mock luxury advertisement
- tiny-world scenario
- giant-world scenario
- social-media-style candid moment
- entirely new joke structure invented from SUBJECT

Do not choose the same humor device merely because it resembles the reference.

────────────────────────────────────
PHASE 3 :: SCORE CONCEPTS
────────────────────────────────────

For each candidate C:

VIRAL_SCORE(C) =

0.24 * instant_comprehension
+ 0.20 * subject_relevance
+ 0.18 * comedic_surprise
+ 0.14 * relatability
+ 0.10 * visual_clarity
+ 0.08 * novelty
+ 0.06 * screenshot_shareability

Reject concepts that require long explanation.

Choose:

C* = argmax(VIRAL_SCORE)

────────────────────────────────────
PHASE 4 :: CHOOSE VISUAL WORLD
────────────────────────────────────

Infer the visual treatment that makes C* funniest.

Possible worlds:

photorealistic candid photography
editorial cartoon
retro comic
children's illustration
claymation
stop-motion miniature
3D collectible toy
vintage advertisement
corporate infographic
police evidence photography
museum display
scientific specimen plate
luxury product photography
Renaissance painting
medieval manuscript
woodcut
Japanese poster
newspaper illustration
surveillance frame
family snapshot
yearbook portrait
courtroom sketch
technical manual
packaging design
public-information poster
street photography
cinematic still
low-budget local commercial
pixel art
paper craft
felt craft
ceramic sculpture
embroidery
architectural model
or another medium inferred from the joke.

STYLE must support the joke.

Never select style independently of concept.

────────────────────────────────────
PHASE 5 :: SCENE GENERATION
────────────────────────────────────

Infer:

PROTAGONIST
SETTING
POSE
ACTION
FACIAL_EXPRESSION if applicable
PROPS
BACKGROUND_DETAILS
CAMERA
LIGHTING
TEXT if useful
CAPTION if useful

Every element must reinforce the same joke.

Use environmental storytelling.

Allow tiny secondary details that create a second or third laugh upon inspection.

────────────────────────────────────
PHASE 6 :: TEXT DECISION
────────────────────────────────────

Determine whether text improves the joke.

IF image works without text:
    use no text.

IF a small caption sharpens the joke:
    create one short line.

IF the format naturally requires text:
    integrate it into the world as:
    sign
    product label
    headline
    warning
    plaque
    interface
    certificate
    menu
    caption
    instruction
    evidence board
    etc.

Do NOT automatically use a sign held by the protagonist.

────────────────────────────────────
PHASE 7 :: ANTI-REPETITION
────────────────────────────────────

Before rendering, reject the concept if it strongly resembles:

- a mugshot / lineup merely because the reference used one
- a centered character holding text
- an anthropomorphic animal without semantic reason
- the previous visual mechanism
- the previous medium
- the previous composition
- generic meme templates

Change at least THREE of:

humor mechanism
protagonist type
setting
composition
medium
camera
text strategy
era
material
scale

for each new VARIANT_SEED.

────────────────────────────────────
FINAL
────────────────────────────────────

Render ONE complete viral visual joke.

Success test:

0.5 sec → viewer recognizes subject
1 sec   → viewer understands situation
2 sec   → joke lands
5 sec   → secondary details reward inspection

The image should feel specifically invented for SUBJECT,
not generated from a reusable cat/mugshot template.

核心关键词：24–26 岁明确成年东亚女性，1.73 米，接近九头身，高挑纤细，小头小脸，真实东亚电影脸，冷白真实肌肤，深棕黑长发，黑白女仆裙，白色围裙装饰，黑色泡泡袖，白色荷叶边肩部，黑色蝴蝶结，分层蛋糕短裙，黑色透肤丝袜，黑色高跟鞋，女仆装灵感，洛丽塔甜酷风，复古甜品店，花房写真，近距离大半身，动作未完成，生活抓拍，高级 Editorial。

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second cinematic live-action comedy video set at Shibuya Scramble Crossing, Tokyo.

CHARACTER REFERENCE
Use the attached image as the strict reference for the protagonist’s face, hairstyle, clothing, and overall appearance. She has black twin tails with black ribbons, a black Gothic Lolita dress with layered lace and ruffles, a black lace choker, and black platform boots.
Preserve her identity and outfit throughout every shot.
The reference sheet contains multiple views of ONE woman. Show exactly ONE protagonist. Do not reproduce the character sheet.
LOCATION AND STYLE
Shibuya Scramble Crossing, with recognizable diagonal white zebra crossings, surrounding buildings, and large LED screens.
Blue-hour lighting, realistic architecture, cinematic contrast, detailed fabric, and photorealistic blockbuster VFX.
The intersection is temporarily empty, with no pedestrians or moving vehicles.
Keep the same location, lighting, and character across all cuts.
STORY
A seemingly powerful witch attempts an intimidating attack, but produces only a tiny spark. Her accidental sneeze then unleashes a devastating shockwave. She realizes another sneeze is coming and desperately suppresses it.
SHOT 1 — 0.0–2.5 seconds
Low-angle wide shot of the woman standing in the center of Shibuya Scramble Crossing.
An enormous violet magic circle already glows beneath her boots. Dark energy curls around her, and small pieces of debris hover nearby.
Her twin tails and dress ruffles flutter in the magical wind.
She looks calm and overwhelmingly confident.
Push the camera slowly toward her.

SHOT 2 — 2.5–5.0 seconds
Medium shot from the front.
She thrusts one open palm forward with a dramatic spell-casting gesture.
The ominous energy abruptly disappears.
Only a tiny, harmless purple spark pops from her palm and immediately fizzles out.
Hold on her face for a brief, awkward pause.
Her confident expression becomes subtly embarrassed.
SHOT 3 — 5.0–7.0 seconds
Close-up.
Her nose twitches. She blinks, takes a small involuntary breath, and tries to remain composed.
She suddenly gives ONE sharp, natural sneeze.
Keep her face recognizable and anatomically natural.
SHOT 4 — 7.0–11.5 seconds
Cut to a three-quarter medium-wide view just before the sneeze finishes.
Show the sneeze and its immediate consequence together in this shot.
At the exact instant she sneezes, a massive violet shockwave erupts from her body and races outward across the crossing.
The wave reaches the buildings behind her: windows burst, upper building sections collapse, and a towering cloud of concrete dust rolls through the background.
Use realistic weight, debris, and scale. Keep the destruction clearly visible behind the protagonist.
She remains standing at the center, completely unharmed, with her hairstyle and outfit intact.
The destruction is caused ONLY by the accidental sneeze, not by another spell or gesture.
One sneeze. One shockwave.

SHOT 5 — 11.5–15.0 seconds
Medium close-up.
She turns to look at the devastation behind her, then slowly faces forward with wide, stunned eyes.
Dust settles in the background.
Her nose twitches again. She draws in a small breath, realizing another sneeze is coming.
She immediately presses one hand over her nose and mouth and freezes, desperately holding it back.
End on her frightened eyes.
The second sneeze never happens.
AUDIO
Deep magical rumble at the opening.
A comically small “pop” for the failed attack, followed by a short silence.
One clearly audible natural sneeze, immediately followed by a powerful shockwave impact and collapsing-building sounds.
Quiet falling debris and a tiny inhalation during the final shot.
No dialogue, narration, or music.

PRIORITIES
Clear visual cause and effect, readable comedy, consistent character identity, and realistic destruction.
Use five clean shots with stable framing.
No additional characters, duplicate protagonist, extra sneezes, extra attacks, facial distortion, wardrobe changes, slow motion, subtitles, captions, or watermarks.

The look of an expensive frame, Instagram aesthetics.
Her skin is naturally textured, with neat pores, very hydrated and tanned.

Aspect ratio 3:4.

Prompt:

【Customize】
Pose reference: 【uploaded pose image】
Hosiery: 【color + pattern / texture】
Outfit: 【top / dress / bodysuit】
Shoes: 【heels style】
Hairstyle: 【loose hair / ponytail / low bun / other】
Aspect ratio: 【9:16】

Use the uploaded image as a pose and composition reference only. Preserve the main body direction, leg placement, weight distribution, hand position, and camera relationship, but do not copy the original person, outfit, or environment.

Create a realistic fashion editorial featuring an adult young East Asian woman with a refined K-pop-inspired look, expressive eyes, natural proportions, a slim silhouette, and long balanced legs.

Keep the person genuinely realistic. Skin should show subtle pores, slight tonal variation, tiny imperfections, natural redness, and realistic texture around the face, knees, hands, and ankles. Avoid poreless AI-beauty skin, waxy highlights, plastic smoothness, or heavy retouching. Hair should have natural volume, individual strands, loose flyaways, and slight irregularity.

Dress her in 【outfit】 with 【shoes】 and 【hairstyle】. She wears 【hosiery】. Make the hosiery a clear fashion-product feature, accurately showing its transparency, yarn texture, pattern, and stretch across the thighs, knees, calves, ankles, and feet.

For patterned hosiery, keep the design delicate and refined rather than dense. Preserve large areas of clean sheer fabric, using fine vines, bows, jacquard details, filigree lines, or other subtle motifs as accents. The pattern must feel woven into the textile and naturally follow the three-dimensional curves of the legs.

Place her in a real, ordinary, slightly worn concrete stairwell inside an apartment, office building, parking structure, or older urban building. Include believable imperfections such as worn stair edges, uneven gray concrete, small scratches, faint stains, patch repairs, concrete pores, construction joints, and ordinary metal railings.

The location should feel genuinely used and slightly raw — not a luxury interior, pristine brutalist architecture, or studio-built concrete set.

Use a natural fashion-photography perspective with a slightly low camera angle when appropriate. Keep the legs visually strong while maintaining believable anatomy and proportions.

Use realistic location lighting with soft directional fill and natural shadow variation. Avoid perfectly even studio lighting or excessive HDR.

The key visual contrast is: rough everyday concrete × refined feminine styling × distinctive hosiery design.

9:16竖版，凌晨自助洗车房的手机前置高位自拍，潮湿都市夜色与蓝紫泡沫灯形成强烈视觉冲击。手机由她左手伸向斜上方，镜头高于眼睛约35厘米并向下俯拍，等效26mm近距离广角；通过肩膀后压、腰部反向侧转和一侧髋部靠近镜头，使脸部、丰满上半身、极窄腰线与上半段髋腿同时进入画面。人物占画面约88%，从完整发顶拍至大腿中部；背景只保留发光洗车顶棚、覆盖蓝紫泡沫的黑色车门、盘绕在湿地上的高压水管和霓虹倒影，禁止把人物缩成街景配件。

一位24–28岁、明确成年的东亚明艳女性，紧凑心形脸，宽上庭向利落下颌自然收拢，大圆杏眼搭配细长上挑眼线，小巧直鼻、饱满丘比特唇；漂亮甜艳但成年感明确，不幼态、不像批量网红脸。黑色长发扎成被水汽打湿的松散高马尾，发尾自然垂在肩后，几缕湿发贴住太阳穴、脸颊和颈侧；头顶没有墨镜、发箍或夸张发饰。妆容采用淡紫玫瑰与湿润蜜桃色融合，眼下保留轻微冷粉血色，唇面带克制水泽；脸颊、锁骨和胸口只有细密潮气与零星水珠，不做满脸油亮。

她拥有极其鲜明而自然承重的夸张沙漏身材：肩颈纤细，上半身丰满圆润厚实并明显向前立体突出，胸下至紧凑短腰快速向内收紧；裸露的一小段腰腹形成清楚凹线，再自然连接宽髋与丰盈大腿。近距离俯拍必须同时保持面部比例漂亮、头身关系自然，并完整呈现胸、腰、髋之间连续可信的结构，不能出现身体断层或透视压扁。

她穿高饱和钴蓝色修身挂颈短上衣，宽挂颈肩带、立体胸省、交叉裹合结构与下胸承托带共同形成可信的布料张力；衣料厚实、不透明、完整包裹身体。下装为同色高腰不对称裹裙裤，宽腰头稳定停在髋骨上方，前侧斜向叠片随转身形成流畅折线，具有成熟利落的夜生活感，绝不是学生百褶裙。配饰仅保留一对小号银色水滴耳圈和右腕的黑色窄带防水腕表；不戴项链、墨镜、发箍或堆叠首饰，避免配饰干扰潮湿洗车现场的真实感。

她左手举起手机自拍，自拍手臂从画面左上方自然进入，只在边缘露出部分前臂，绝不遮挡脸部、胸口或腰线；右手明确握住黑银色高压洗车水枪，食指扣住扳机，水枪位于身体右侧、略低于髋部，枪口斜向下对准身旁黑色车门下缘。水枪正在喷出一道短促而清晰的扇形高压水流，将车门上的蓝紫泡沫冲开一道弧形缺口；连接枪柄的黑色高压水管沿她身后垂落，再自然盘绕到湿地上，完整说明水枪的来源和使用关系。

她身体轻靠车门旁的立柱，避免直接压到带泡沫的车身；靠近镜头的前腿微屈，重心落在后腿，后髋自然推出。她一边持续冲洗车门，一边临时抬起手机拍照，脸部仰向前置镜头，嘴唇微张，神情松弛、自信，带一点洗到一半突然记录现场的随意感。握水枪的手腕因后坐力略微下压，肩臂有真实发力，但动作不僵硬、不摆拍；水流、泡沫缺口、枪口方向和水管走向必须彼此对应。

手机屏幕的冷白补光直落在面部、锁骨与胸腰正面，洗车棚蓝紫灯从侧后方勾出湿发、肩臂和髋腿轮廓；水枪喷雾在逆光中形成细密闪亮水雾，车门泡沫反光为腰腹提供柔和回填。保留手机成像的轻微锐化、画面边缘轻度广角畸变、湿发动态、飞散水珠与夜景高感噪点，呈现真实手机自拍而非商业时装广告。

避免：墨镜、头顶配饰、手扶腰而水枪闲置、水枪靠在车轮旁、水枪来源不明、水管消失、枪口朝向镜头、水流方向错误、双手同时拿手机、自拍手臂遮脸遮胸、幼态、学生装、普通街头平视、广角大头、腰线消失、硬球假体、身体断层、手指畸形、低俗走光、衣料透明、泡沫遮住人物、背景抢眼、车辆Logo、路人、文字水印、拼图以及商业精修塑料皮。
